summary: The LCD remains blank because the I2C address defined in your code does not match the actual hardware address of the LCD module.

causes.title: I2C address mismatch
causes.why: The code initializes the LCD with address 0x3F (`LiquidCrystal_I2C lcd(0x3F, 16, 2);`), but the runtime trace confirms the device is responding at 0x27 (`NST|i2c_scan=0x27`).
causes.check: Run an I2C scanner sketch to confirm the address of your specific LCD module.
causes.fix: Change the address in your code to `LiquidCrystal_I2C lcd(0x27, 16, 2);`.

rule_findings.title: LCD I2C address mismatch (0x3F in code, 0x27 on the part)
rule_findings.evidence: The LCD only answers on its own address; the screen stays blank.
rule_findings.fix: Use 0x27 in the LiquidCrystal_I2C constructor, or run an I2C scanner.

rule_findings.title: I2C device is at 0x27, code uses 0x3F
rule_findings.evidence: The startup I2C scan found a device, but not at the address in the code.
rule_findings.fix: Change the address in the code to 0x27.
